result.question: Quais os 3 hospitais com maior valor médio de serviço hospitalar (VAL_SH) por estado (MA e RS), considerando hospitais com mais de 500 internações?
result.gold_sql:
SELECT estado, "CNES", avg_val_sh
FROM (
    SELECT mu."SG_UF" AS estado,
           i."CNES",
           ROUND(AVG(i."VAL_SH"), 2) AS avg_val_sh,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mu."SG_UF" ORDER BY AVG(i."VAL_SH") DESC) AS rn
    FROM internacoes i
    JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES"
    JOIN municipios mu ON h."MUNIC_MOV" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D"
    WHERE mu."SG_UF" IN ('MA', 'RS') AND i."VAL_SH" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY mu."SG_UF", i."CNES"
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 500
) sub
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY estado, avg_val_sh DESC;
